record.category: serverless Postgres with a compute layer

free_tier.stated: 200,000 operations per month, 2 GB storage, 50 databases, 10 direct connections, and Prisma Compute with 1 million requests

per_object_cap.stated: 2 GB storage on Free; 10 connections direct and 10 pooled

retention.stated: a database persists while the plan is active; the Accelerate cache retires on 2026-12-01

egress.terms: the database itself has no egress fee on any published plan; Prisma Compute includes 10 GB of outbound bandwidth a month and then USD 0.025 per GB
egress.free_allowance: no database egress fee; 10 GB per month on Prisma Compute

record.interface_detail: the Postgres wire protocol; the Prisma ORM; a Management API
record.tooling: the Prisma ORM, psql, any Postgres client
record.chaining: 50 databases on one free account is the widest per-tenant fan-out in this class, if 10 connections per database is enough

limits.value: 200,000 operations per month; every query is one operation
10 direct connections and 10 pooled connections on Free

identity_cost.detail: email signup; no card on Free

record.reliability_note: no suspension, throttle or data-loss event is recorded on the pages read
record.confidence_note: the pricing page's plan table was read on 2026-10-22, and the 10-connection ceiling is on it beside the operation count and the storage allowance.

evidence.proved: Free: 200k operations, 2 GB storage, 50 databases, connection limit pooled 10, connection limit direct 10, connection idle timeout 60 minutes, data transfer unlimited; Prisma Compute Free 1M requests, 360 GB-hours provisioned memory, 4 vCPU-hours active CPU, 10 GB outbound bandwidth

record.price_per_tb_month: USD 8 per million operations; storage USD 2.00/GB beyond 10 GB on Starter
record.notes: 200,000 operations a month is 6,667 a day, which is a prototype and not a service. The 10-connection ceiling is the second wall and it is the one that shows up when a pooler is added and the pool itself is the limit.
